en.bdb: From the shop of holy congregation, through the Word, the merchandise of God’s name is procured.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਟਿ ਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: pooraa poore vaT k aakh salaaheeaai|

en.bdb: How to praise Him? The measuring criteria of  the perfect Lord are perfect.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿਸਾਹੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: kadhe na hovai ghaT sachee patisaaheeaai|

en.bdb: The warehouse of the True King is never deficient.
Cultivating the True Guru, those who earn through Him get merged into His inexhaustible Being.
The company of the saints is manifestly great; one should always be in and with it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਵਲ ਇਕਤੇ ਸਟਿ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਹੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: chaaval ikate saT na dhoojee vaaheeaai|

en.bdb: Husk in the form of maya should be separated from the rice of life

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦੀ ਫਾਹੀ ਕਟਿ ਦਾਦਿ ਇਲਾਹੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: jam dhee faahee kaT dhaadh ilaaheeaai|

en.bdb: With strokes of discipline during this very life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜੇ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਘਟਿ ਸੁ ਢੇਰੀ ਢਾਹੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)je dhoot sa(n)ghaT su dderee ddaaheeaai|

en.bdb: All the five evil propensities, should be decimated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿਹਟਿ ਸੁ ਖੇਤਿ ਉਮਾਹੀਐ ॥੬॥
verses.translit_en: paanee jiau harihaT su khet umaaheeaai ||6||

en.bdb: As the  water of well keeps the fields green, the field of the consciousness should be kept verdant (with the help of shabad).
